taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: The complete production codebase may be deployed while insufficient modules remain disabled, partial, or shadow-only.
Dependency groups define build order and test prerequisites without requiring throwaway MVP architecture.
Free-only production is declared best-effort unless every critical external dependency provides an applicable SLA.
MCP protocol revisions and target clients are governed by a compatibility matrix and conformance tests.
Production live paths use bounded precomputed alpha matching; heavy Alpha Lab jobs and artifact imports follow the isolated export/import trust boundary.
